integrity: The conditional-variance identity, uniqueness and small-survival asymptotic are analytic. Numerical checks are supplementary and do not certify infinite statements; independent verification and historical-priority review have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact observations, independent exchangeable dropout, known indicators, fixed finite sensor number, and Brownian-bridge integral estimation only. Joint large-network limits, data-dependent failures, and noisy surviving values are not covered.
title: Universal high-dropout spacing law for Brownian-bridge quadrature
